summary: Full end-to-end verification of the new KI-Ökosystem (KI-Labor, KI-Team) plus regression of KI Trader. Backend: 26 API tests + 27 offline unit tests -> all green. Frontend: KI-Trader panel opens after Admin login (Admin / Dean06Greif!/Admin), KI-Labor & KI-Team panels reachable with all four tabs (research/ml/memory/market), role cards for research_analyst + market_observer with role-specific fields, real user route for /api/ai/research/run (LLM: mistral/mistral-small-latest, status=ok), /api/ai/ml/train (Optuna+XGBoost pipeline runs, cv_auc ~0.5 on demo data as expected, importances + best_params returned), /api/ai/observer/run (produces 22 snapshots), /api/ai/analyze (22 real LLM decisions), /api/ai/memory/stats?health=true returns 200 despite Supabase 'ai_knowledge' table missing (Mongo fallback works, warning surfaced in UI). Role reset flow: model change -> Reset button appears -> click restores preset and toast 'Voreinstellung wiederhergestellt'.

minor.issue: Backend accepts empty username as long as ADMIN_USER matches the truthy check ('not user or user == ADMIN_USER or not user'); harmless but semantically overly permissive.

issues: React dev-warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' (hydration warning from a role model dropdown that renders a <span> tag inside <option> for the preset badge). Not a functional bug but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Optional: remove <span> inside <option> in role model select to silence React hydration warning.
Optional: tighten /api/auth/login username check (require non-empty username when ADMIN_USER is configured).
critical_code_review_comments: ai_roles.py: chain() properly falls back to _available_chain when the preset provider has no key – verified by test_chain_appends_available_providers; the OpenRouter+Mistral-only setup works.

ai_memory.py + ai_lab.py: memory endpoints tolerate missing Supabase table (PGRST205) and keep the Mongo primary storage functional – verified live (39 entries) and matched by UI 'Supabase nicht erreichbar' banner.
ai_ml_lab.py: train pipeline validates end-to-end (cv_auc, importances, best_params returned) even at n_trials=3; explanation via LLM is optional and gracefully missing on cheap runs.
routers/ai_lab.py: dataset endpoint returns 500 on load_training_data errors – acceptable, but consider a structured JSON error (currently raises HTTPException with truncated string).
ai_lab.py memory_stats uses `memory.health() if health else memory.stats()` – both paths were tested and return 200 even when Supabase is unreachable (great).
seed_data_creation: None – used the existing demo seed (backend/scripts/seed_ai_lab_demo.py: 1 backtest, 1 optimizer run, 90 AI decisions, 90 market snapshots).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_ai_lab_api.py is now the authoritative integration test for the new KI ecosystem endpoints. It covers /api/ai/lab/status, research (data/report/run + admin gate), ml (status/dataset/predict/train n_trials=3/settings/auth gate), observer (status/run/snapshots), memory (stats?health=true, entries – asserts NO 500 when Supabase table missing), roles (contains research_analyst+market_observer with preset, update sets user_configured=true, reset restores preset), and KI Trader regression (analyze/status/insights/learn). LLM tests use ~60-90s timeouts (mistral fallback). Full run ~65s.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A – no bugs found. Three initial test failures were my mis-shaped assertions (research/data returns nested {digests, counts}; lab/status.kinds is a dict of {code: label}; /api/ai/analyze.decisions is a count-int, not a list) and were fixed in the test file.
